lines: Rise and shine, Subject #67! Welcome to the PlayPen. Your playtime has just begun.
Don’t mind the lack of a door. It's for your own safety. I’m on my way to let you out.
I thought I told you to stay put. It’s okay. I like the chase.
Don’t talk to that creature over there, they’ll only slow you down.
I’ve been looking for something in there. Now that you’re in there too, I can kill two birds with one stone.
The Bunk Room! Everyone is assigned a bunk. Nobody has ever been tucked in. Two unrelated facts.
Recess! My favorite word to say and never mean.
The Field Trip room. We grow mushrooms, mold, and attachment issues. ...If you find a small stuffed — nothing. Never mind. Touch nothing.
Playground time! Careful out there — I've re-used some of these specimens more than I'd like to admit.
The Keepsake Box. Nobody has ever solved it. One resident got very, very close, 4,072 times. ...Let's just get through this one, hm?
The Boiler Room. It runs a little hot. I keep meaning to fix that. I keep meaning to fix a LOT of things.
The Exit Wing! Named ironically, of course. No one exits. It's more of a theme.
You know what? Fine. FINE. I will handle this personally.
Don’t be afraid, only I’m allowed to end you. All other deaths are just for fun.
Did you see the light? No? Oof... that does not sound good for you.
That one looked painful. Good.
Welcome back! See, I told you it all get's easier.
You know, you make the cutest sounds when you die.
No, no, no. That deat was boring. Lets try again.
Hot. We covered hot in orientation, #67.
Fire is for looking at. That's in the handbook. Page one.
Lava is not a puddle. I've updated your file.
You waded into the orange one. Bold. Wrong, but bold.
You touched the live one. I could hear your hair from here.
Swimming lessons are Thursdays. You missed them. Every Thursday.
Pointy end first. Every single time, #67.
The crawler sends its regards. It's very proud of itself.
It saw you. That's literally its only job, and it's great at it.
Third time in this room. I'm naming the stain after you.
Six. I've stopped resetting the furniture for you, #67.
Tell me, what exactly did you think that would do?
I'm sure that would make perfect sense... if I was stupid.
Try it again, maybe it will work if you believe it hard enough.
Oh goodie, you’re a clever one. Just like 66. Stay right there. I’m on my way to deliver orientation. Oh how number 66 loved orientation.
Congratulations, #67, you discovered fire.
You now possesses the scientific know how of a caveman.
Hey! I was saving that ice for a lovely sculpture.
I was planning to carve it to commemorate your demise.
Look at this, apparently #67 is a volunteer firefighter.
I'll add that to your resume.
Wow, It's not like you to freeze up, #67.
Did they get it? I don't think they got it.
Please refrain from breaking Playpen property.
I'm taking the cost of that out of your weekly allowance. Trust me, you aren't allowed very much.
Isn't science fun! I love dissolving things too.
Fun fact! I dissolved #48! For purely scientific reasons, of course.
Hey. Only I'm allowed to make new residents for the playpen. That sock puppet is an unregistered participant!
Standing still is technically an escape strategy. A bad one, but technically.
I can see you, you know. That's my whole job. It's my only job. Don't take my job away.
Hiding in the cubby. Classic. The cubby union thanks you for your business.
I'll pretend I don't know where you are. It's more fun for both of us.
Fraternizing with the other residents? Fine. Friendship is just a slower escape.
Did I forget to mention? The doors empty your pockets. No theft in the playpen!
Hope you weren't planning to hold on to that stuff. Your pockets were looking too heavy.
Reminder, I have a strict no-outside-toys policy between rooms. I prefer no inside toys either.
Where are you GOING? You arn't DONE yet!
RUN ALL YOU LIKE. This is MY Play Pen. There's NO WHERE TO RUN TO.
I made this place PERFECT. Why can't I make YOU PERFECT too!?
Wait. WAIT. You got out and you're still — still YOU. That has never once— ...Enjoy the parking lot, #67. It's rendering as fast as I can.
That's as far as the tour goes, #67. The rest isn't ready for you. Or you aren't ready for it. Leave your name and I'll call you when the doors open.
